videoToImage.name: Video to Image
videoToImage.desc: Extract frames from a video and download them as images.

page.heroDesc: Extract frames from a video and download them as images. Everything happens in your browser: nothing is uploaded.
page.q1: Are my videos uploaded to a server?
page.a1: No. Everything is processed 100% in your browser (canvas + JS). Your video never leaves your device, so it even works offline after loading.
page.q2: What formats and quality can I choose?
page.a2: MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI. Choose interval (0.05s to 5s) or exact count, format PNG/JPEG/WebP and quality 1-100%. You can also remove duplicates and capture frames manually.
page.q3: Is there a size or frame limit?
page.a3: No limit from us, but 1000+ frames can use a lot of RAM. We warn you if we estimate >100MB and you can cancel anytime. Chrome/Edge on PC is recommended for long videos.

backgroundRemover.name: Background Remover
backgroundRemover.desc: Remove the background from an image with AI, right in your browser.

page.heroDesc: Remove the background from any image with AI. Everything happens in your browser: nothing is uploaded.
page.q1: How does it remove the background without uploading?
page.a1: It uses the RMBG-1.4 model downloaded once from Hugging Face and running in your browser via WebAssembly. Your photo is never sent to a server.
page.a2: JPG, PNG, WebP with a well-defined subject. The model crops precisely and you can zoom/compare before downloading as transparent PNG.
page.q3: Why is the first time slow?
page.a3: It downloads ~50MB of AI model and caches it. The second time is instant. If you see 'Loading model', wait with a good connection.

imageEnhancer.name: Image Enhancer
imageEnhancer.desc: Upscale resolution and restore faces with AI, right in your browser.

page.heroDesc: Upscale 4x and restore faces with AI. Everything happens in your browser: nothing is uploaded.
page.q1: What does the AI actually do?
page.a1: Local pipeline: (optional) Swin2SR denoises, Real-ESRGAN x4 upscales, MediaPipe detects faces and GFPGAN/CodeFormer restores them with feather blend. All in WebAssembly/WebGPU.
page.q2: How big is it and how long does it take?
page.a2: Models total several hundred MB the first time and stay cached. On mobile or without GPU it can take minutes. Chrome/Edge on PC is recommended.
page.a3: No. Nothing is sent to our server. Models come from jsDelivr/Hugging Face/Google Storage directly to your browser.

colorizeImage.name: Colorize Photos
colorizeImage.desc: Colorize black & white photos with AI (DeOldify), right in your browser.

page.heroDesc: Colorize black & white photos with AI (DeOldify). Everything happens in your browser: nothing is uploaded.
page.dropTitle: Drop a black & white photo here
page.q1: How does it colorize black & white photos?
page.a1: DeOldify (artistic) predicts color on a 512x512 version and merges it with the brightness of your original at full resolution in YCbCr space to keep sharpness.
page.a2: Portraits and scenes with good contrast. JPG/PNG/WebP up to 2000px (we auto-resize if larger).
page.q3: Where does the color come from, is it real?
page.a3: It's an AI prediction, not the historical original color. You can compare before/after with the slider.
